worldcombat.skill.drumbeating.summary: Each beat sends a root head over real support toward that beat's fixed destination. Damage occurs only on arrival. The final arriving contact binds and slows; missing ground stops that root path.
worldcombat.skill.drumbeating.descriptio: Play %3$s beats separated by %4$s: early beats use %1$s power and the last uses %2$s. Travelling segments add no extra damage.
The root travels up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick and settles within radius %3$s, for at most three enemies per beat. Entity positions are resampled for each beat; chosen points remain fixed.
The final hit lowers Speed by %1$s stages, with a binding carrier for %2$s and a brief root for %3$s. %4$s short root strands mark actual contact without replacing terrain.
worldcombat.skill.drumbeating.deep.on: Deep root: the roots stay longer, press one more Speed stage and break through wider, at the cost of a lighter beat and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.drumbeating.deep.off: Rolling beat: a heavier, faster round of drumbeats whose roots stay briefly and press one Speed stage.
worldcombat.skill.drumbeating.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.drumbeating.growth.0: From level %1$s the final beat rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.drumbeating.growth.1: From level %1$s the final beat rises to %2$s and the roots bind %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.drumbeating.use.0: Pin a foe through the ground from a distance
worldcombat.skill.drumbeating.use.1: Roll several beats for repeated damage, the last pressing Speed down and pinning the legs
worldcombat.skill.drumbeating.use.2: Leave a ring of roots at the target's feet
worldcombat.skill.drumbeating.preference: On: the roots stay longer, press one more Speed stage and break through wider, at the cost of a lighter beat and a longer cooldown. Off: a heavier, faster rolling beat.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of drumming. Larger values open from further out.
On: prefer a target that is moving or fleeing, pinning its Speed down first. Off: treat it as an ordinary mid-range candidate.
world_combat.move.drumbeating.text.bind: Roots bind the legs, Speed down %1$s stage
